verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs list local browser modes alongside Browserbase. You can launch a local browser with `localBrowser.launch`, attach over CDP to any Chromium you already run, and persist user data to a local directory, so the core automation runs on your own infrastructure. Some conveniences are tied to Browserbase, notably server-side caching and the session dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license or self-hosting docs, clarity on which features (e.g., server-side caching) work without Browserbase, independent hands-on confirmation of fully self-hosted runs.
